The idea of this subreddit is to post your goals and the steps you will take to achieve it.

This is in order to create the habits and routines necessary to succeed long term. I think that as you write down progress week after week honestly, you can get a really clear picture of where you are succeeding and where you are failing.

Hints and Guidelines:

I suggest that we use weekly goals, as this gives more flexibility than daily goals (for instance you could have a weekly goal to exercise 5 times a week, which allows you to have 2 rest days. That is easier than trying to make daily goals of exercising.)

I will be updating my Goals thread daily. I suggest that others the same, as it will allow us all to start a routine for success.
